messages:
Lena Ortiz: Hey team, first day and my Dell boots to BitLocker recovery asking for a 48-digit key. Screen shows 'Managed by Redwood Inference (Intune)'. I don't have the key.

Chris (IT): Welcome! DM the service tag and a pic of the screen. Don’t try random keys.

Lena Ortiz: Sent DM. Service tag: 7K9D4G1.

intune-bot: Intune lookup: device(Serial=7K9D4G1) -> registered by staging-lab-02. BitLocker escrow: NOT FOUND.

Nadia - Endpoint Admin: Looks like protector wasn't backed up from staging. We can reimage (fast) or remote-unlock if you prefer. Any data on it?

Lena Ortiz: No data, reimage is fine—want dev tools asap.

Chris (IT): Kicking off Autopilot reimage now. Keep it plugged and on network. I'll assign temporary local admin for 3 hours after provisioning.

intune-bot: Autopilot task 'reimage-1785012345' started by Chris at 2026-08-03T09:12:00Z.

Lena Ortiz: OOBE completed and desktop up. Company Portal shows pending compliance.

Nadia - Endpoint Admin: Forcing sync and backing up BitLocker protector to Intune now. Run `manage-bde -protectors -get C:` in elevated PS and paste the protector ID if present.

Lena Ortiz: Protector ID matches recovery screen ID.

Nadia - Endpoint Admin: Key backed up and emailed to your work address. Granting temporary admin now. Install instructions: Ubuntu WSL 22.04, VSCode via winget, Docker Desktop via winget.

intune-bot: Temporary admin 'temp-admin-3h' assigned to LENA\lena.ortiz by Nadia. Expires 3 hours.

Lena Ortiz: Everything installed, Company Portal shows compliant. Thanks y'all! :smile:
